notes: Books: loot in house_books plus one thematic table each, and the `books` discovery pool.

glassblowing_book is the only learn source for the four already-enabled glass recipes; its `:glassblowers_crucible` jar variant is excluded (needs the unobtainable glassblowers_crucible_tool pseudo-tool).

polycarbonate_sheet + makeshift_vacuum_mold open the CDDA `plastic_molding` requirement group. makeshift_vacuum_mold is battery powered in CDDA, so it needs an electricity.json `device` profile to be usable as a 4-charge tool (added; same shape as food_processor/electric_spinwheel).
can_sealer unblocks the nine enabled canned* variants of broth, broth_meat and juice. recipe:can_tomato:canned_big / :canned_medium stay blocked on `tomato`, which belongs to the foods group.
hat_hard, knee_pads and magnifying_glass have recipes that are on the whitelist exclude list; they need recipesInclude (magnifying_glass also needs `lens`, staged later in this group).

Held for later (staged then removed on the coordinator's stop-at-8 instruction, no files left behind): material_limestone, lens, thread_kevlar, kevlar_patch, button_plastic, button_wood, simple_crank, giant_wood_screw. Verified while briefly staged: with those ids the currently excluded keys recipe:chem_baking_soda, recipe:magnifying_glass, recipe:sheet_kevlar (+ :electric_spinwheel, :spinningwheel), recipe:sheet_kevlar_patchwork, recipe:oil_press_manual and recipe:screw_press_tool all become obtainable once moved from whitelist/recipes.json `exclude` to `include` via recipesInclude.
batch 3 added the first two cookbooks of this group (10 staged): cookbook_sushi and cookbook_indian.

batch 4 added the twenty books of this group plus knife_hunting (31 staged). Every book trains a game skill: cooking (offalcooking, sweets_book, baking_book, dairy_book, vinegar_maker, manual_canning via copy-from mag_cooking), survival (survival_book, atomic_survival, textbook_botany), fabrication (textbook_fabrication, textbook_carpentry, carpentry_book, recipe_melee, textbook_weapwest, textbook_weapeast, welding_book, metal_casting_book, bronze_book, plastics_book) and melee (manual_knives, whose CDDA stabbing skill the loader folds in)
knife_hunting is staged here rather than in gear because its whole point is to give manual_knives and recipe_melee a recipe the Prologue can actually craft

textbook_botany, metal_casting_book, textbook_carpentry, survival_book and atomic_survival unlock no exclusive recipe today: they are skill books (survival 8 / fabrication 7 ladders) and alternative learn paths. bronze_book and offalcooking get their exclusives in batches 6 and 7

recipe:raw_butter and its :shake variant are dairy_book exclusives but stay unclaimed: both need the CHURN 1 quality and milk_cream, and neither is obtainable. They remain enabled through recipesInclude so they light up as soon as a churn or milk_cream is imported; dairy_book already unlocks recipe:icecream, so the book is not dead

recipe:vinegar is claimed although its batch is 40 L of liquid - right at the container rule. It fits: the wooden_barrel staged in batch 2 holds 100 L, and eight of the plastic buckets from the same batch also cover it

ten keys needed recipesInclude (toastem4, raw_butter + :shake, icecream, pilot_light, water_faucet, battleaxe, bagh_nakha, butterfly_swords, knee_pads): all are whitelisted results that were excluded while no enabled book taught them

manual_sealing and manual_canning together open the whole preserving family: 41 jar and can rows for results that were already whitelisted (soups, sauce_red, can_beans, jam_fruit, con_milk, can_tomato). All were obtainable but unlearnable, which is why they sat in whitelist/recipes.json exclude; can_sealer (staged earlier in this group) is the tool they need
batch 5 finished this group: three skill books (tailor, firstaid and mechanics, each the first book past its current cap) and the eight material ids (43 staged)

the materials pay off twice: as recipe inputs and as uncraft outputs. thread_kevlar alone was being dropped from 78 uncraft rows, button_plastic from 32, button_wood from 27, sheet_nylon from 6, kevlar_patch from 2

recipe:magnifying_glass is not claimed for this batch: it was already enabled and obtainable before it (lens plus an earlier recipesInclude entry did that). recipe:can_sealer is claimed instead - simple_crank was its last missing component, so the can sealer that batch 4 made learnable can now also be built

the eight recipesInclude keys this batch lists were already present in whitelist/recipes.json from the earlier held work; they are recorded here so the staging file documents what the group depends on
